name: Meeting Outcomes Orchestrator
tagline: An intelligent agent that dynamically reasons about your meeting and orchestrates the right tools — research, emails, action items, slides, calendar, Slack, Notion, and Jira — automatically.
description: A SOTA ReAct-powered post-meeting agent that uses dynamic tool discovery and LLM-driven reasoning to transform meetings into actionable work. Unlike hardcoded agents, it reasons about what the user actually needs, selects tools dynamically from a modular registry, executes them in parallel, and synthesizes polished outputs. Features: web search, Wikipedia, web scraping, personalized email drafting, slide deck generation, structured action item extraction, multi-source research, Google Calendar integration, SQLite memory across meetings, Slack notifications, Notion page creation, and Jira ticket creation. All integrations are optional — the agent works with zero configuration.
